description: Power BI User Tracker Unlock Insights into User Interactions The Power BI User Tracker is a custom visual designed to help organizations monitor and analyze user interactions within Power BI Online reports and dashboards. By integrating seamlessly with Azure Application Insights, this tool empowers teams to track usage metrics, evaluate report effectiveness, and optimize dashboard performance based on real user behavior. Key Features Usage Metrics: Analyze report views, session durations, and user interactions to understand how reports are used. Custom Event Tracking: Log specific user activities, such as filter interactions, to assess report interactivity. Audit Reports and Dashboards: Perform regular audits to ensure reports meet organizational standards and user needs. Adoption Patterns: Monitor report adoption trends to identify key usage drivers and promote high-value reports. Trend Analysis: Identify emerging usage patterns to refine current reports or create better-tailored dashboards. Data Security: All feedback and usage data is processed and stored securely within Azure Application Insights, ensuring it never leaves your organization’s control. Who Benefits? This visual is ideal for: Reporting Managers: Optimize reporting strategies based on actual usage data. Project Managers: Ensure dashboards align with project goals and stakeholder needs.
